_comment: Every tool the agent can reach. This file is the ONLY thing that changes
when a capability is added or removed.
The Week 9 deliverable is bolting the ticket-history server on without
touching the agent. Delete its block below and the agent loses two tools
and keeps working. Add a third server and it gains that server's tools on
the next start. No Python is edited either way.
'trusted' is not decoration. A server's tool DESCRIPTIONS go straight into
the model's prompt, so a hostile server can write instructions there. An
untrusted server's descriptions are scanned by agent/guard.py before the
model ever sees them. See results/w9_results.md.

servers.name: helpcentre
servers.note: Ours. Hybrid retrieval over the billing-migration corpus.

servers.name: ticket-history
servers.note: Bolted on in Week 9. Another team's system, so it is not trusted.
